title: Cyber threat intelligence company Brandefense completes new investment round
summary: Webrazzi and Egirisim report that threat intelligence company Brandefense has completed a new investment round. New investors are Yapay Zeka Fabrikası, Maxis and Sharks & Partners, joined by existing investors TechOne VC, Zorlu Capital Partners (Gelecek Etki Fonu), Sabancı Ventures and Finberg. The size of the round was not disclosed, per Webrazzi. Brandefense says it will use the money for AI-powered products and global growth.
plain: Threat intelligence firm Brandefense has closed a new funding round from new and existing investors. The amount was not disclosed.
exec: A threat intelligence vendor has new backing for AI products and global growth; the round's size was not disclosed.

validation.note: Webrazzi and Egirisim, two publishers, both state the round and the investors; no company press release read. Egirisim gives Wilmington, USA as headquarters.
